caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity for two models, labeled Transformer and MoHD, across different ratios of shared sub-dimensions. The x-axis is labeled "Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims" and features ordinal tick labels progressing sequentially at 0/4, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, and 4/4. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL." and uses a linear scale ranging from 10.0 to 12.5, with horizontal dashed grid lines appearing at regular numerical intervals of 0.5. The plot displays two lines, with a light blue shaded region filling the space between them. The line representing the Transformer is depicted as a dashed red line with no markers. It maintains a constant horizontal trajectory throughout the plot, starting at an x-axis value of 0/4 and ending at 4/4 with a steady y-axis value of approximately 11.65. The line representing MoHD is plotted as a solid blue line with square markers. It begins at an x-axis value of 0/4 with a y-axis value of approximately 11.1, declines to roughly 10.65 at 1/4, and continues to decrease to about 10.5 at 2/4. The line reaches its lowest point at 3/4 with a y-axis value of approximately 10.25, before rising to conclude at the end of the x-axis (4/4) with a y-axis value of roughly 10.75.
